en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To acquaint students with the chemistry of basic nutrients (water, fats, sacharides, peptides) and minor substances (vitamins, mineral elements and others).

en.content: 1.The composition of foods, biogenic elements (allowance 1/0)2.Fats: fatty acids, homolipids, heretolipids (allowance 2/0)3.Significant oxidative reactions in food (allowance 2/0)4.Calculations in chemistry, Laboratory (No. 1) (allowance 0/4) a.evaluation and interpretation of analytical methods5.Monosacharides, reaction of sugars in food processing (allowance 2/0)6.Oligosaccharides and polysacharides (allowance 2/0)7.Water: functions of water, drinking water, water in foods (allowance 1/0)8.Calculations in chemistry, Laboratory (No. 2) (allowance 0/4) a.calibration of analytical methods9.Aminoacids, oligopeptides (allowance 2/0)10.Polypeptides, proteins (allowance 2/0)11.Vitamins, provitamines (allowance 2/0)12.Mineral elements, toxic elements, contaminants (allowance 2/0)
